Description

Baseus BA04 5.0 Bluetooth Receiver Adapter

The Baseus BA04 Bluetooth Receiver Adapter is a compact and versatile USB adapter that brings Bluetooth 5.0 wireless connectivity to your laptop or desktop computer. The adapter ensures high-performance data transfer and a stable connection between your computer and other Bluetooth-enabled devices. You can enjoy a range of up to 20 meters, allowing you to use your devices even when they are several meters away from your computer. Whether you're listening to music on wireless headphones or streaming audio to Bluetooth speakers, you can enjoy an uninterrupted audio experience without interference. The Baseus BA04 Bluetooth Receiver Adapter is also backward compatible, meaning it can connect to devices that utilize older versions of Bluetooth. It features easy Plug & Play installation, and setting up the adapter is hassle-free. The Baseus BA04 Bluetooth Receiver Adapter is compatible with Windows operating systems, including Windows 7, 8, 8.1, 10, and 11, making it suitable for a wide range of computers.
